title: Bounded-above finite-free model at a cohomological upper bound
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, let $b$ be an integer and let $C$ be an object of the derived category $D(R)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. If $C$ is pseudo-coherent, meaning that it admits a quasi-isomorphism from a bounded-above complex of finitely generated projective $R$-modules, and $H^i(C)=0$ for every $i>b$, then there is a quasi-isomorphism $P^\bullet\to C$ from a complex $P^\bullet$ of finitely generated free $R$-modules with $P^i=0$ for every $i>b$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma 15.66.5 (used in Lemma 15.76.2, Tag 0658)
